**Built for Apple Intelligence**
--------------------------------

Mac Studio helps pros push the boundaries of what they can do, and Apple Intelligence elevates those experiences even further. Writing is even more dynamic with Writing Tools, which can help users rewrite, proofread, or summarize — whether they are responding to emails or using summarization to draft an abstract in seconds in apps like Scrivener. Pros can minimize unnecessary distractions with Priority Notifications and use live transcription in Notes to record and easily recap important meetings. With new Siri improvements, users can move fluidly between spoken and typed requests to accelerate tasks throughout their day, and Siri can answer thousands of questions about Mac features and settings, with step-by-step instructions like how to combine PDF files in Preview. With access to ChatGPT seamlessly integrated into Writing Tools and Siri, users can tap into ChatGPT’s expertise, so they can get things done even faster and easier. Users can choose to enable ChatGPT integration, and are in full control of when to use it and what information is shared with ChatGPT. Users can also explore creative new ways to express themselves visually with Image Playground, and drop their original image right into their paper, mood board, or Keynote presentation. Whether users are researching their next project, editing a video, creating new designs, or preparing for their next lecture, these new tools will help pros be even more productive.

Designed to protect users’ privacy at every step, Apple Intelligence uses on-device processing, meaning that many of the models that power it run entirely on device. For requests that require access to larger models, Private Cloud Compute extends the privacy and security of Mac into the cloud to unlock even more intelligence. When using Private Cloud Compute, users’ data is never stored or shared with Apple; it is used only to fulfill their request.

**macOS Sequoia: An Unrivaled Experience**
------------------------------------------

[macOS Sequoia](https://www.apple.com/macos/macos-sequoia/)
 completes the new Mac Studio experience with a host of exciting features, including iPhone Mirroring, which allows users to wirelessly interact with their iPhone, its apps, and notifications directly from their Mac.3 Pros can now move files, photos, and videos between iPhone and Mac as easily as they can drag and drop between apps on Mac. Easier window tiling means users can stay organized with a window layout that works best for them. The all-new Passwords app gives convenient access to passwords, passkeys, and other credentials, all stored in one place. And users can apply beautiful built-in backgrounds for video calls, which include a variety of color gradients and system wallpapers, or upload their own photos. Safari, the world’s fastest browser,4 now surfaces relevant information on sites in Highlights; summarizes articles in the redesigned Reader; keeps videos front and center in a new Video Viewer; and lets users hide distracting items with Distraction Control. Gaming gets even more immersive with features like Personalized Spatial Audio and improvements to Game Mode, along with a breadth of exciting titles, including Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition by CD PROJEKT RED, Assassin’s Creed Shadows, and more.

Next month, macOS Sequoia 15.4 will make it easier than ever to set up the new Mac Studio with iPhone.5 By simply bringing iPhone close to Mac, users can quickly and conveniently sign in to their Apple Account to get their files, photos, messages, passwords, and more on their new Mac Studio.

**The Ultimate Studio Setup**
-----------------------------

Mac Studio, together with Studio Display, empowers creative users to build the studio of their dreams. Studio Display perfectly pairs with Mac Studio with its expansive 27-inch 5K Retina display, 12MP Center Stage camera, studio-quality three-mic array, and six-speaker sound system with Spatial Audio. For users working on HDR workflows, Pro Display XDR offers a 32-inch Retina 6K display with up to 1600 nits of peak HDR brightness. Customers can also add matching Magic accessories — including Magic Keyboard with Touch ID, Magic Trackpad, and Magic Mouse — that beautifully complement the elegant design of Mac Studio and Studio Display.

  ![The 27-inch 5K Retina Studio Display with Mac Studio. ](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/images/2025/03/apple-unveils-new-mac-studio-the-most-powerful-mac-ever/article/Apple-Mac-Studio-Studio-Display-setup-250305_big.jpg.large_2x.jpg)

Mac Studio was designed to pair beautifully with the expansive 27-inch 5K Retina Studio Display, making it the ultimate studio setup.

[](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/images/2025/03/apple-unveils-new-mac-studio-the-most-powerful-mac-ever/article/Apple-Mac-Studio-Studio-Display-setup-250305.zip)

**Better for the Environment**
------------------------------

The new Mac Studio is designed with the environment in mind. As part of Apple 2030, the company’s ambitious goal to be carbon neutral across its entire carbon footprint by the end of this decade, Apple is transitioning to renewable electricity for its manufacturing, and investing in wind and solar projects around the world to address the electricity used to power all Apple products, including Mac Studio. Today, all Apple facilities run on 100 percent renewable electricity — including the data centers that power Apple Intelligence.

To achieve Apple 2030, the company is designing products with more recycled and renewable materials, which further drives down the carbon footprint. Mac Studio features over 30 percent recycled content overall, including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets. Mac Studio uses far less energy and materials than desktops in its class, and is free of mercury, brominated flame retardants, and PVC. The packaging is entirely fiber-based, bringing Apple closer to its goal to remove plastic from all packaging by the end of 2025.6

Some features, applications, and services may not be available in all regions or all languages. 
    
    *   With Apple Trade In, customers can trade in their current computer and get credit toward a new Mac. Customers can visit [apple.com/shop/trade-in](https://www.apple.com/shop/trade-in/)

    *   AppleCare+ for Mac provides unparalleled service and support. This includes unlimited incidents of accidental damage, battery service coverage, and 24/7 support from the people who know Mac best.

In these guided online sessions, a Specialist can walk them through setup, or focus on features that help them make the most of their new device.     *   Customers in the U.S. who shop at Apple using Apple Card can pay monthly at 0 percent APR when they choose to check out with Apple Card Monthly Installments, and they’ll get 3 percent Daily Cash back — all up front. More information — including details on eligibility, exclusions, and Apple Card terms — is available at [apple.com/apple-card/monthly-installments](https://www.apple.com/apple-card/monthly-installments/)
        .
    
    **About Apple** Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV+. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.

Apple no longer offers M3 Ultra Mac Studio with original highest RAM configuration
==================================================================================

 [![Avatar for Zac Hall](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/af01c840dac8281fd5f1986a8504e54222700437fa19c3083e578c1ddf6386a6?s=60&d=mm&r=r)](https://9to5mac.com/author/apollozac/)
[Zac Hall](https://9to5mac.com/author/apollozac/)
 | Mar 5 2026 - 12:12 pm PT

[15 Comments](https://9to5mac.com/2026/03/05/apple-no-longer-offers-m3-ultra-mac-studio-with-original-highest-ram-configuration/#comments)

![Mac Studio m4 Max m3 ultra](https://i0.wp.com/9to5mac.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/6/2025/03/mac-studio-m4-max-m3-ultra.jpg?w=1500&quality=82&strip=all&ssl=1)

A year ago today, Apple unveiled the M4 Max and M3 Ultra Mac Studio desktop computer. In addition to Thunderbolt 5 and SSD storage configurable to 16TB, Apple advertised the Mac Studio as featuring up to 512GB of unified memory. As of this week, the highest RAM upgrade option is no longer available.

Apple [highlighted](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/03/apple-unveils-new-mac-studio-the-most-powerful-mac-ever/)
 the highest RAM configuration in the press release for the M3 Ultra Mac Studio:

> Mac Studio is a powerhouse for AI, capable of running large language models (LLMs) with over 600 billion parameters entirely in memory, thanks to its advanced GPU and up to 512GB of unified memory with M3 Ultra — the most ever in a personal computer.

As [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/03/05/mac-studio-no-512gb-ram-upgrade/)
 notes, customers ordering a new M3 Ultra Mac Studio today no longer have the option to configure the desktop Mac with 512GB RAM. The issue is likely due to global supply constraints thanks in large part to high memory needs for servers powering AI.

The M3 Ultra Mac Studio still offers the most configurable RAM in a Mac with its 256GB memory option. That’s compared to the M2 Ultra Mac Pro which offers up to 192GB RAM, and M4 Max/M5 Max machines that support up to 128GB RAM.

With Thunderbolt 5, up to 512GB of unified memory, and an up to 16TB SSD, all in a compact design, the ultimate pro desktop delivers even more performance
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[Apple](https://macsources.com/category/featured/apple-news/)
 today announced the new [Mac Studio](https://www.apple.com/mac-studio/)
, the most powerful Mac ever made, featuring M4 Max and the new M3 Ultra chip. The ultimate pro desktop delivers groundbreaking pro performance, extensive connectivity now with Thunderbolt 5, and new capabilities in its compact and quiet design that can live right on a desk. Mac Studio can tackle the most intense workloads with its powerful CPU, Apple’s advanced graphics architecture, higher unified memory capacity, ultrafast SSD storage, and a faster and more efficient Neural Engine. It provides a big boost in performance compared to the previous generation, and a massive leap for users coming from older Macs.

Mac Studio is a powerhouse for AI, capable of running large language models (LLMs) with over 600 billion parameters entirely in memory, thanks to its advanced GPU and up to 512GB of unified memory with M3 Ultra — the most ever in a personal computer. It’s also built for Apple Intelligence, the personal intelligence system that transforms how users work, communicate, and express themselves, while protecting their privacy. The new Mac Studio is available to pre-order today, with availability beginning March 12.

“The new Mac Studio is the most powerful Mac we’ve ever made,” said John Ternus, Apple’s senior vice president of Hardware Engineering. “A complete game-changer for pros around the world — powering both home and pro studios — Mac Studio sits in a class of its own, offering a staggering amount of performance in a compact, quiet design that fits beautifully on your desk. With this new Mac Studio, we’re delivering even more extreme performance with M4 Max and M3 Ultra, support for half a terabyte of unified memory, up to 16TB of superfast storage, and Thunderbolt 5 connectivity. Mac Studio truly is the ultimate pro desktop.”

**Mac Studio with M4 Max: A Performance Juggernaut**

The new Mac Studio with M4 Max is the perfect choice for video editors, colorists, developers, engineers, photographers, creative pros, and other users who need to blaze through intensive workflows. It delivers phenomenal single-threaded CPU performance with the world’s fastest CPU core, along with outstanding multithreaded CPU performance for complex workloads. Featuring an up to 16-core CPU, an up to 40-core GPU, over half a terabyte per second of unified memory bandwidth, and a Neural Engine that is over 3x faster than M1 Max, Mac Studio with M4 Max can run on-device AI models incredibly fast. Mac Studio with M4 Max is up to 3.5x faster than Mac Studio with M1 Max, and is up to 6.1x faster than the most powerful Intel-based 27-inch iMac.1

The GPU in M4 Max also brings Apple’s advanced graphics architecture to Mac Studio for the first time, including dynamic caching, hardware-accelerated mesh shading, and a second-generation ray-tracing engine for more seamless content creation and gaming. Mac Studio with M4 Max starts at 36GB of unified memory, with support for up to 128GB, so users can do everything from sorting through thousands of images with speed and precision, to producing complex compositions with hundreds of tracks, plug-ins, and virtual instruments, all played in real time. And with the powerful Media Engine in M4 Max, which features two ProRes accelerators, Mac Studio performance is outstanding for videographers who can effortlessly work with multiple streams of 4K ProRes.

**Mac Studio with M4 Max enables:**1

*   Up to 1.6x faster image processing in Adobe Photoshop when compared to Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 2.9x faster when compared to the 27-inch iMac with Core i9. 
*   Up to 2.1x faster build performance when compiling code in Xcode when compared to Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 3.1x faster when compared to the 27-inch iMac with Core i9. 
*   Up to 1.2x faster ProRes transcode performance in Compressor when compared to Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 2.8x faster when compared to the 27-inch iMac with Core i9. 
*   Up to 1.6x faster video processing performance in Topaz Video AI when compared to Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 5x faster when compared to the 27-inch iMac with Core i9.

**Mac Studio with M3 Ultra: The Pinnacle of Pro Performance**

Mac Studio with M3 Ultra pushes demanding workflows to a whole new level. It delivers nearly 2x faster performance than M4 Max in workloads that take advantage of high CPU and GPU core counts, and massive amounts of unified memory.2 Mac Studio with M3 Ultra is up to 2.6x faster than Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 6.4x faster than the 16-core Intel Xeon W-based Mac Pro.1 With the new M3 Ultra, Mac Studio features an up to 32-core CPU with 24 performance cores, 50 percent more than any previous Ultra chip and the most CPU cores ever in a Mac. It also offers an up to 80-core GPU, more than any Apple silicon chip; a powerful 32-core Neural Engine for on-device AI and machine learning (ML); and a high-bandwidth memory architecture that delivers over 800GB/s of unified memory bandwidth.

Mac Studio with M3 Ultra starts with 96GB of unified memory, which can be configured up to 512GB — the most unified memory ever in a personal computer — and up to 16TB of ultrafast SSD storage, so content and data can be kept locally. That’s enough storage for over 12 hours of 8K ProRes video. The advanced graphics architecture brings Dynamic Caching, along with hardware-accelerated mesh shading and ray tracing, so graphics workflows like GPU-based renderers are up to 2.6x faster than Mac Studio with M1 Ultra.

**Mac Studio with M3 Ultra enables:**1

*   Up to 16.9x faster token generation using an LLM with hundreds of billions of parameters in LM Studio when compared to Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, thanks to its massive amounts of unified memory.
*   Up to 2.6x faster scene rendering performance in Maxon Redshift when compared to Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 6.4x faster when compared to the 16-core Intel-based Mac Pro with Radeon Pro W5700X.
*   Up to 1.1x faster basecalling for DNA sequencing in Oxford Nanopore MinKNOW when compared to Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 21.1x faster when compared to the 16-core Intel-based Mac Pro with Radeon Pro W5700X. 
*   Up to 1.4x faster 8K video rendering performance in Final Cut Pro when compared to Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 4x faster when compared to the 16-core Intel-based Mac Pro with Radeon Pro W5700X.

**Thunderbolt 5 for High-Bandwidth Accessories and Expansion**

The new Mac Studio features Thunderbolt 5 ports that deliver transfer speeds up to 120 Gb/s, up to 3x faster than the prior generation, enabling faster external storage, expansion chassis, and powerful hub solutions. For those who rely on PCIe expansion cards for their workflows, Thunderbolt 5 allows users to connect an external expansion chassis with higher bandwidth and lower latency. And with M3 Ultra, Mac Studio now drives up to eight Pro Display XDRs at the full 6K resolution. Mac Studio also offers a wide array of connectivity within easy reach for pros, including a 10Gb Ethernet port, an HDMI port, an SDXC card slot on the front to conveniently import photos and video, along with built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

**Built for Apple Intelligence**

Mac Studio helps pros push the boundaries of what they can do, and Apple Intelligence elevates those experiences even further. Writing is even more dynamic with Writing Tools, which can help users rewrite, proofread, or summarize — whether they are responding to emails or using summarization to draft an abstract in seconds in apps like Scrivener. Pros can minimize unnecessary distractions with Priority Notifications and use live transcription in Notes to record and easily recap important meetings. With new Siri improvements, users can move fluidly between spoken and typed requests to accelerate tasks throughout their day, and Siri can answer thousands of questions about Mac features and settings, with step-by-step instructions like how to combine PDF files in Preview. With access to ChatGPT seamlessly integrated into Writing Tools and Siri, users can tap into ChatGPT’s expertise, so they can get things done even faster and easier. Users can choose to enable ChatGPT integration, and are in full control of when to use it and what information is shared with ChatGPT. Users can also explore creative new ways to express themselves visually with Image Playground, and drop their original image right into their paper, mood board, or Keynote presentation. Whether users are researching their next project, editing a video, creating new designs, or preparing for their next lecture, these new tools will help pros be even more productive.

Designed to protect users’ privacy at every step, Apple Intelligence uses on-device processing, meaning that many of the models that power it run entirely on device. For requests that require access to larger models, Private Cloud Compute extends the privacy and security of Mac into the cloud to unlock even more intelligence. When using Private Cloud Compute, users’ data is never stored or shared with Apple; it is used only to fulfill their request.

**macOS Sequoia: An Unrivaled Experience**

[macOS Sequoia](https://www.apple.com/macos/macos-sequoia/)
 completes the new Mac Studio experience with a host of exciting features, including iPhone Mirroring, which allows users to wirelessly interact with their iPhone, its apps, and notifications directly from their Mac.3 Pros can now move files, photos, and videos between iPhone and Mac as easily as they can drag and drop between apps on Mac. Easier window tiling means users can stay organized with a window layout that works best for them. The all-new Passwords app gives convenient access to passwords, passkeys, and other credentials, all stored in one place. And users can apply beautiful built-in backgrounds for video calls, which include a variety of color gradients and system wallpapers, or upload their own photos. Safari, the world’s fastest browser,4 now surfaces relevant information on sites in Highlights; summarizes articles in the redesigned Reader; keeps videos front and center in a new Video Viewer; and lets users hide distracting items with Distraction Control. Gaming gets even more immersive with features like Personalized Spatial Audio and improvements to Game Mode, along with a breadth of exciting titles, including Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition by CD PROJEKT RED, Assassin’s Creed Shadows, and more.

Next month, macOS Sequoia 15.4 will make it easier than ever to set up the new Mac Studio with iPhone.5 By simply bringing iPhone close to Mac, users can quickly and conveniently sign in to their Apple Account to get their files, photos, messages, passwords, and more on their new Mac Studio.

**The Ultimate Studio Setup**

Mac Studio, together with Studio Display, empowers creative users to build the studio of their dreams. Studio Display perfectly pairs with Mac Studio with its expansive 27-inch 5K Retina display, 12MP Center Stage camera, studio-quality three-mic array, and six-speaker sound system with Spatial Audio. For users working on HDR workflows, Pro Display XDR offers a 32-inch Retina 6K display with up to 1600 nits of peak HDR brightness. Customers can also add matching Magic accessories — including Magic Keyboard with Touch ID, Magic Trackpad, and Magic Mouse — that beautifully complement the elegant design of Mac Studio and Studio Display.

**Better for the Environment**

The new Mac Studio is designed with the environment in mind. As part of Apple 2030, the company’s ambitious goal to be carbon neutral across its entire carbon footprint by the end of this decade, Apple is transitioning to renewable electricity for its manufacturing, and investing in wind and solar projects around the world to address the electricity used to power all Apple products, including Mac Studio. Today, all Apple facilities run on 100 percent renewable electricity — including the data centers that power Apple Intelligence.

To achieve Apple 2030, the company is designing products with more recycled and renewable materials, which further drives down the carbon footprint. Mac Studio features over 30 percent recycled content overall, including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets. Mac Studio uses far less energy and materials than desktops in its class, and is free of mercury, brominated flame retardants, and PVC. The packaging is entirely fiber-based, bringing Apple closer to its goal to remove plastic from all packaging by the end of 2025.6

**Pricing and Availability**

*   Customers can pre-order the new Mac Studio starting today on [apple.com/store](https://www.apple.com/store/)
     and in the Apple Store app in 28 countries and regions, including the U.S. It will begin arriving to customers, and will be in Apple Store locations and Apple Authorized Resellers, starting Wednesday, March 12.
*   Mac Studio starts at **$1,999** (U.S.) and **$1,799** (U.S.) for education. Additional configure-to-order options are available at [apple.com/store](https://www.apple.com/store/)
    . 
*   More information on Studio Display, Pro Display XDR, and Magic accessories is available at [apple.com/shop/buy-mac](https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/)
    .
*   Apple Intelligence is available on all Mac models with M1 and later, in localized English for _Australia_, _Canada_, _Ireland_, _New Zealand_, _South Africa_, the _UK_, and the _U.S._ Additional languages — including French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (simplified), English (Singapore), and English (India) — will be available in April, with more languages coming over the course of the year, including Vietnamese. Some features, applications, and services may not be available in all regions or all languages. 
*   With Apple Trade In, customers can trade in their current computer and get credit toward a new Mac. Customers can visit [apple.com/shop/trade-in](https://www.apple.com/shop/trade-in/)
     to see what their device is worth. 
*   AppleCare+ for Mac provides unparalleled service and support. This includes unlimited incidents of accidental damage, battery service coverage, and 24/7 support from the people who know Mac best. 
*   Every customer who buys directly from Apple Retail gets access to Personal Setup. In these guided online sessions, a Specialist can walk them through setup, or focus on features that help them make the most of their new device. Customers can also learn more about getting started with their new device with a Today at Apple session at their nearest Apple Store.
*   Customers in the U.S. who shop at Apple using Apple Card can pay monthly at 0 percent APR when they choose to check out with Apple Card Monthly Installments, and they’ll get 3 percent Daily Cash back — all up front. More information — including details on eligibility, exclusions, and Apple Card terms — is available at [apple.com/apple-card/monthly-installments](https://www.apple.com/apple-card/monthly-installments/)
    .

**About Apple**

Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV+. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.

[![The updated Mac Studio with the M4 Max and M3 Ultra chips](https://cdn.neowin.com/news/images/uploaded/2025/03/1741186731_mac_studio_1_story.jpg)](https://cdn.neowin.com/news/images/uploaded/2025/03/1741186731_mac_studio_1.jpg)

In addition to launching [the updated MacBook Air](https://www.neowin.net/news/apple-updates-macbook-air-with-the-m4-chip-new-sky-blue-color-and-a-lower-price-tag/)
, Apple is unveiling new Mac Studio computers. The latest model is now powered by more powerful processors and offers massive amounts of RAM and storage for the most demanding tasks.

Visually, the new Mac Studio is identical to its predecessors with all the changes inside the case. The Mac Studio now has the M4 Max and the new M3 Ultra processors. The M4 Max has up to 16 CPU cores and 40 GPU cores, while the M3 Ultra packs up to 32 CPU cores and 80 GPU cores.

Compared with the original M1 Max Mac Studio, the M4 Max-powered variant is 1.6 times faster in Photoshop, 2.1 times faster in Xcode, 1.2 times faster in ProRes transcoding, and 1.6 times faster in video processing in Topaz Ai. As for the M3 Ultra (no, it is not a typo; it is indeed called M3 Ultra, not M4 Ultra), it is 2.6 times in rendering with Maxon Redshift, 1.4 times faster in 8K video rendering in Final Cut, and 16.9 times faster in token generation in LM Studio compared with the M1 Ultra.

[![The updated Mac Studio with the M4 Max and M3 Ultra chips](https://cdn.neowin.com/news/images/uploaded/2025/03/1741186743_mac_studio_story.jpg)](https://cdn.neowin.com/news/images/uploaded/2025/03/1741186743_mac_studio.jpg)

The power button is where it should be!

Apple has also updated connectivity, giving Mac Studio owners the ability to use Thunderbolt 5 with its whopping 120Gbps throughput. Besides ultra-fast data transfer, Thunderbolt 5 on the M3 Ultra can drive up to eight Pro Display XDR monitors in their full 6K resolution. Other ports include a 10Gbps Ethernet, two USB Type-A, a headphone jack, and an SDXC card reader.

Also worth noting is that there are no odd power button placements. [Unlike the new Mac mini](https://www.neowin.net/news/specs-appeal-comparing-the-new-m4-mac-mini-with-m2-and-m1-mac-minis/)
, the Mac Studio has its power button within adequate reach.

[![The updated Mac Studio with the M4 Max and M3 Ultra chips](https://cdn.neowin.com/news/images/uploaded/2025/03/1741186737_mac_studio_2_story.jpg)](https://cdn.neowin.com/news/images/uploaded/2025/03/1741186737_mac_studio_2.jpg)

The new Mac Studio with the M4 Max starts at $1,999. For this money, you get 36GB of unified memory and 512GB SSD (configurable up to 128GB of RAM and 8TB SSD). The M3 Ultra, however, offers more impressive configurations. The base variant costs $3,999, and it packs 96GB of RAM and 1TB SSD. If that is not enough, you can spec it all the way up to 512GB of RAM and 16 TB. Such a config will set you back an eye-watering $14,099.

Both M4 Max and M3 Ultra Mac Studio are [now available for](https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/mac-studio)
 [preorder](https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/mac-studio)
. Shipments begin on March 12.

results.title: Apple's New Mac Studio Is the Most Powerful Mac Ever
results.description: Mac Studio with M3 Ultra starts with 96GB of unified memory, configurable up to 512GB, and up to 16TB of SSD storage. Apple notes that that's enough space for over 12 hours of 8K ProRes video.
results.markdown:
[](https://petapixel.com/2025/03/05/apples-new-mac-studio-is-the-most-powerful-mac-ever/# "Share on facebook")
[](https://petapixel.com/2025/03/05/apples-new-mac-studio-is-the-most-powerful-mac-ever/# "Share on X")
[](https://petapixel.com/2025/03/05/apples-new-mac-studio-is-the-most-powerful-mac-ever/# "Share on Flipboard")
[](mailto:?subject=Apple%27s%20New%20Mac%20Studio%20Is%20the%20Most%20Powerful%20Mac%20Ever&body=https%3A%2F%2Fpetapixel.com%2F2025%2F03%2F05%2Fapples-new-mac-studio-is-the-most-powerful-mac-ever%2F%3Futm_source%3DPetaPixel%26utm_medium%3Demail%26utm_campaign%3Demail-share "Email this article")
[](https://petapixel.com/2025/03/05/apples-new-mac-studio-is-the-most-powerful-mac-ever/#comments "Comments")

![A person in a bright green shirt works at a desk with two large monitors displaying video editing software. A Mac mini and multiple peripherals are on the desk, and the room has wooden accents and low lighting.](https://petapixel.com/assets/uploads/2025/03/Apple-Mac-Studio-Studio-Display-setup-250305.jpg)

Alongside the [new MacBook Air](https://petapixel.com/2025/03/05/apples-new-m4-powered-macbook-air-is-more-powerful-and-affordable/)
, Apple announced its most powerful Mac ever, the M4 Max-powered Mac Studio.

Featuring the [M4 Max announced last fall](https://petapixel.com/2024/10/30/apples-m4-m4-pro-and-m4-max-chips-promise-huge-performance-gains-and-ai-prowess/)
 and all-new M3 Ultra chip, the new Mac Studio desktop promises “groundbreaking pro performance” and better connectivity. Thunderbolt 5 has arrived in the Mac Studio, empowering users to deliver transfer speeds up to 120 Gb/s, up to three times faster than the prior generation. Thunderbolt 5 enables users to connect an external expansion chassis to their Mac Studio. Those using the M3 Ultra Mac Studio can connect up to eight Pro Display XDRs at full 6K resolution.

Apple calls the Mac Studio an AI powerhouse, “capable of running large language model (LLMs) with over 600 billion parameters entirely in memory.” The Mac Studio with M3 Ultra supports up to 512GB of unified memory, the most ever in a personal computer — not just a Mac, but any personal computer.

![Two square shapes display Apple chip designs on a dark background. The left shows "M4 MAX" with a purple gradient. The right shows "M3 ULTRA" with a multicolor gradient. Both feature the Apple logo above the text.](https://petapixel.com/assets/uploads/2025/03/Apple-Mac-Studio-M4-Max-and-M3-Ultra-chips-250305.jpg)

The Mac Studio comes with either the M4 Max or the brand-new M3 Ultra

“The new Mac Studio is the most powerful Mac we’ve ever made,” says John Ternus, Apple’s senior vice president of Hardware Engineering.

“A complete game-changer for pros around the world — powering both home and pro studios — Mac Studio sits in a class of its own, offering a staggering amount of performance in a compact, quiet design that fits beautifully on your desk. With this new Mac Studio, we’re delivering even more extreme performance with M4 Max and M3 Ultra, support for half a terabyte of unified memory, up to 16TB of superfast storage, and Thunderbolt 5 connectivity. Mac Studio truly is the ultimate pro desktop.”

![A person sits at a keyboard in a music studio, facing two computer monitors displaying music production software. A "RECORDING" sign and speakers are on the desk. Papers and electronic devices are on the wooden desk.](https://petapixel.com/assets/uploads/2025/03/Apple-Mac-Studio-lifestyle-250305.jpg)

While the M3 Ultra gets high marks for its unified memory and connectivity performance, there is much more to it than that. The brand-new M3 Ultra delivers nearly twice as much performance as the M4 Max in CPU- and GPU-intensive workloads. It is also up to 2.6 times faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Ultra and 6.4 times faster than the 16-core Intel Xeon W-based Mac Pro.

M3 Ultra features up to 32 CPU cores, 24 of which are performance cores. This is another record for Mac, and 50 percent more than the M2 Ultra. M3 Ultra has up to an 80-core GPU, yet another record.

Mac Studio with M3 Ultra starts with 96GB of unified memory, configurable up to 512GB, and up to 16TB of SSD storage. Apple notes that that’s enough space for over 12 hours of 8K ProRes video. Speaking of video, the new Mac Studio with M3 Ultra is up to 1.4 times faster with 8K video rendering in Final Cut Pro compared to the Mac Studio with M1 Ultra and up to four times faster than the most powerful Intel-based Mac Pro.

![A sleek computer monitor displays graphic design software, showing an image of a person in futuristic red clothing and sunglasses. The setup includes a compact silver computer and a modern, minimalist stand.](https://petapixel.com/assets/uploads/2025/03/Apple-Mac-Studio-M4-Max-Adobe-Photoshop-250305.jpg)

Although the M3 Ultra is a record-setting chip, the Mac Studio with M4 Max is no slouch. Apple positions it as the “perfect choice” for photographers, video editors, and other creative pros. The M4 Max features an up to 16-core CPU and up to 40 GPU cores. It is up to 3.5 times faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Max and up to 6.1 times faster than the most powerful Intel-based 27-inch iMac.

Mac Studio with M4 Max starts with 36GB of unified memory, although it supports up to 128GB.

The M4 Max features two ProRes accelerators, driving “outstanding” 4K ProRes video editing capabilities. It is up to 1.6 times faster in Photoshop compared to the Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 2.9 times faster than the most powerful Intel-baed iMac. It promises significantly speedier video performance as well.

![A large computer monitor displaying 3D modeling and rendering software interfaces sits atop a sleek, minimalist silver stand. Below the monitor is a compact, silver desktop computer with ventilation and ports. The screen shows colorful digital designs.](https://petapixel.com/assets/uploads/2025/03/Apple-Mac-Studio-M4-Max-3D-software-250305.jpg)

Pricing and Availability
------------------------

The Mac Studio starts at $1,999 and is [available to order](https://www.apple.com/mac-studio/)
 today ahead of release on March 12.

The base model features an M4 Max chip with a 14-core CPU, 32-core GPU, 36GB of unified memory, and 512GB of SSD storage. It features two USB-C ports on the front alongside an SD card slot, plus four Thunderbolt 5, two USB-A, HDMI, and 10Gb Ethernet ports on the rear. This machine supports up to five displays.

![Front view of a compact, silver computer unit. It features a minimalist design with a smooth surface. The lower section is perforated for ventilation, while the front has two narrow vertical slots and a circular power indicator.](https://petapixel.com/assets/uploads/2025/03/Apple-Mac-Studio-front-250305.jpg)

![Rear view of a silver computer with perforated metal design. Visible ports include Thunderbolt, USB-C, USB-A, HDMI, Ethernet, and a power button on the right side. A power connector is centrally located.](https://petapixel.com/assets/uploads/2025/03/Apple-Mac-Studio-back-250305.jpg)

The M3 Ultra Mac Studio starts at $3,999 and comes standard with 96GB of unified memory and 1TB of storage. This chip has a 28-core CPU and a 60-core GPU. It trades in its two front USB-C ports for a pair of Thunderbolt 5 ports, joining the same arrangement of rear ports, bringing it to six Thunderbolt 5 ports. The machine supports up to eight displays in total.

If someone wants the ultimate Mac Studio power, including the most powerful M3 Ultra with 32 CPU cores and 80 GPU cores, plus 512GB of memory and a 16TB SSD, the price skyrockets to an eye-watering $14,099. The most powerful Mac ever does not come cheap.

Frequently Asked Questions
--------------------------

*   ### I’m switching from a PC to a Mac. Is it easy to set up my new Mac and transfer my files?
    
    Yes, switching to Mac is simple, and learning how to use Mac feels just as easy as using your iPhone. Mac pairs seamlessly with your iPhone and other Apple devices.
    
    If you already have an iPhone, setting up your Mac is a snap. Just bring your iPhone near your Mac, and Setup Assistant signs you in to your Wi-Fi network and Apple Account. Your files, photos, messages, passwords, and more are transferred from iCloud right to your new Mac.
    
    Don’t have an iPhone? No problem. With Migration Assistant preinstalled on every Mac, you can easily transfer your documents, apps, accounts, and settings from a PC or an existing Mac. Once the transfer is complete, everything will be ready on your new Mac.
    
    Need more help? With Personal Setup, you get free online, one-on-one sessions with a Specialist who walks you through setup and shows you how to make the most of your new Mac. Best of all, you can join whenever works for you, from wherever you are.
    
*   ### Does Apple offer any special discounts or promotions to higher education students, parents, and teachers?
    
    Apple has an Education Store dedicated to your needs. You’ll find discounts, promotions, and bundle deals on Mac, iPad, software, and accessories. You can also access tools and resources to learn how you can better use your Apple devices, software, and apps to enhance learning and teaching.
    
    Products eligible for education discounts are marked with a graduation cap icon. You may need to verify your eligibility with an active school email or other documentation during checkout. Verification varies by country.
    
    [Shop the Education Store (Opens in a new window)](https://www.apple.com/us-edu/store)
    
*   ### What’s the fastest way to get my order, and what are my delivery options?
    
    If you need a Mac right away, visit your local Apple Store to check in-stock availability and options for same-day pickup. In most metro areas, we offer same-day scheduled courier delivery on available in-stock items from an Apple Store. The two-hour delivery fee is $9. You’ll choose a delivery date and time during checkout. Subject to availability. Delivery options, which you can select during checkout, depend on your location and the product availability. While many Mac configurations are ready to ship or pick up in a store, some customized selections may impact your delivery estimates and options.
    
    Orders placed on apple.com can only be shipped within the country or region of purchase. Visit the online store of the location where you want your products delivered.
    
*   ### Can I connect my Mac to additional displays?

 ![Apple Intelligence feature Priority Messages in Mail app](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/apple-intelligence/priority_messages__gadfuiq0e0i2_large.jpg)

Get time-sensitive messages at the top of your inbox — like an invitation for a meeting in an hour or a contract that needs your signature by midnight. And Mail summarizes messages so you can get the gist of an email without even opening it.

  ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/apple-intelligence/privacy_startframe__dgbgqau1psmu_large.png)  ![Privacy Apple logo](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/apple-intelligence/privacy_endframe__reqciaz7iwiq_large.png) ![Privacy Apple logo](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/apple-intelligence/privacy_endframe__reqciaz7iwiq_large.png)

### Great powers come with great privacy.

Apple Intelligence is designed to protect your privacy at every step. It’s integrated into the core of your Mac through on‑device processing. So it’s aware of your personal information without collecting your personal information.

And with groundbreaking Private Cloud Compute, Apple Intelligence can draw on larger server-based models, running on Apple silicon, to handle more complex requests for you while protecting your privacy.

Design
------

Outsized performance.

Width: 7.7”

Height: 3.7”

 ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/design/internals/hw_elements_case__cf1pppj511jm_large.jpg)

Fits right in.

 ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/design/form/fits_in_hw__h21te5w61ze6_large.jpg)

  ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/design/form/design-hero_startframe__dgksa0o21t26_large.jpg)  ![Studio Display and Mac Studio with multi-camera video editing workflow in DaVinci Resolve Studio](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/design/form/design-hero_endframe__bj22uplysjbm_large.jpg) ![Studio Display and Mac Studio with multi-camera video editing workflow in DaVinci Resolve Studio](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/design/form/design-hero_endframe__bj22uplysjbm_large.jpg)

DaVinci Resolve Studio

Pause Play Replay

Thanks to the power and efficiency of Apple silicon, Mac Studio lets M4 Max and M3 Ultra — and your imagination — run unrestrained within an unbelievably small footprint. Designed to fit perfectly under most displays, putting tremendous power and connectivity within arm’s reach, Mac Studio is a high-performance computer unlike any other.

Plays it cool and quiet.

Within the 7.7-inch-square Mac Studio enclosure lies a thermal system designed to let M4 Max or M3 Ultra fly through intensive tasks at lightning-fast speeds. Even with so much incredible power, Mac Studio stays quiet, so it never interferes with your workflow.

 ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/design/thermals/cooling_startframe__e2l4c6dzetua_large.jpg)

  ![The thermal system for Mac Studio](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/design/thermals/cooling_endframe__bgti6crfcd8i_large.jpg) ![The thermal system for Mac Studio](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/design/thermals/cooling_fallback__d2a9m48zrhyu_xlarge.jpg)

Powerful connections.
---------------------

Create the studio of your dreams with unmatched versatility. Mac Studio features Thunderbolt 5 with transfer rates up to 120Gb/s — three times faster than Thunderbolt 4 — and supports Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3.[16](https://www.apple.com/mac-studio/#footnote-18)
 Drive external displays, directly offload SDXC cards, connect high-speed peripherals, or use an external chassis for PCIe expansion to build your ideal creative playground.

 ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/connectivity/icon_thunderbolt__czv4l2s77maa_large.png)

Thunderbolt 5 connectivity up to 3x faster than Thunderbolt 4.

PCIe

High-speed PCI expansion enabled with external chassis — up to 120Gb/s.

 ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/connectivity/hw_front__fdwj7u28jpqq_large.jpg)

### Front Ports

*   2x USB-C or 2x Thunderbolt 5[17](https://www.apple.com/mac-studio/#footnote-19)
    
*   1x SDXC

 ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/connectivity/hw_back__clg2z0t42zyq_large.jpg)

### Back Ports

*   4x Thunderbolt 5
*   1x 10Gb Ethernet
*   2x USB-A

*   1x HDMI
*   1x headphone jack

Mac Studio and the environment.
-------------------------------

*   [Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)](https://www.apple.com/environment/pdf/products/desktops/Mac_Studio_PER_March2025.pdf)
    

*    ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/decarbonize/recycle__fdsr306d4z6u_large.png)
    
    ### Made with 30% recycled material by weight.
    
    Recycled Material
    -----------------
    
    **Our approach.**
    
    Using recycled materials, like 100% recycled aluminum in the enclosure, reduces the need to mine new material, which avoids the carbon emissions and environmental impacts of mining.
    
    [Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)](https://www.apple.com/environment/pdf/products/desktops/Mac_Studio_PER_March2025.pdf)
    
    **How you can help.**
    
    You can protect the earth’s precious resources by trading in, passing down, or recycling devices and accessories you no longer use. You can bring them into any Apple Store for free, secure recycling. We also offer other ways to recycle, including mail-in options.
    
    [Learn how to trade in or recycle devices](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/trade_in/#recycle)
    
*    ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/decarbonize/bolt__b9062mwym2xe_large.png)
    
    ### Manufactured with 35% renewable electricity.
    
    Renewable Electricity
    ---------------------
    
    **Our approach.**
    
    Using electricity from renewable sources — like wind and solar — instead of fossil fuels across our global supply chain significantly reduces carbon emissions from manufacturing Apple products.
    
    [Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)](https://www.apple.com/environment/pdf/products/desktops/Mac_Studio_PER_March2025.pdf)
    
    **How you can help.**
    
    To conserve energy, Mac desktops automatically sleep when the display is off. You can reduce energy consumption while your Mac is on and in use by enabling Low Power Mode. Go to System Settings > Energy to turn it on.
    
    [Learn more about Low Power Mode](https://support.apple.com/en-us/101613)
    
*    ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/decarbonize/box__dek5afu1xk6e_large.png)
    
    ### Ships in 100% fiber-based packaging.
    
    Package and Ship
    ----------------
    
    **Our approach.**
    
    Mac Studio comes in a 100% fiber-based box as part of our commitment to remove plastic from the packaging of all Apple products.
    
    [Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)](https://www.apple.com/environment/pdf/products/desktops/Mac_Studio_PER_March2025.pdf)
    
    **How you can help.**
    
    New Apple products come in paper packaging that’s 100% fiber-based. In most places, you can put the entire box into your household recycling bin. You can also bring Apple packaging to any Apple Store and we’ll recycle it for free.
    
    [Learn more about recycling](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/trade_in/#recycle)
    

Our values lead the way.
------------------------

*    ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/values-router/icon_carbon_neutral__d1n9hsmipqmq_large.png)
    
    ### A plan as innovative as our products.
    
    We’re committed to bringing net emissions to zero across our entire carbon footprint by 2030.
    
    [Learn more about environment](https://www.apple.com/environment/)
    
    [](https://www.apple.com/environment/)
    
*    ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/values-router/icon_privacy__bg790xrcdvgy_large.png)
    
    ### Privacy. That’s Apple.
    
    Privacy is a fundamental human right. Every product and service is designed to help keep your data safe and secure.
    
    [Learn more about privacy](https://www.apple.com/privacy/)
    
    [](https://www.apple.com/privacy/)
    
*    ![](https://www.apple.com/v/mac-studio/m/images/overview/values-router/icon_accessibility__bfri58wjdl9e_large.png)
    
    ### Innovation that’s accessible by design.
    
    Our products and services are designed for everyone, with built-in features to help you do what you love, your way.
    
    [Learn more about accessibility](https://www.apple.com/accessibility/)
    
    [](https://www.apple.com/accessibility/)

![Apple Mac Studio 2025 (M3 Ultra 32-core / 80-core GPU / 512GB RAM / 4TB SSD) specifications and in-depth review](https://www.turbovs.com/images/268/5213_300.jpg)

Apple Mac Studio 2025 (M3 Ultra 32-core / 80-core GPU / 512GB RAM / 4TB SSD)
============================================================================

Manufacturer: **Apple**

The Apple Mac Studio 2025, configured with the M3 Ultra processor, represents the high end of Apple's compact desktop lineup. Built around a 32-core CPU running at up to 3.7 GHz across its performance cores, this configuration pairs that processing headroom with **512GB of unified RAM** — the maximum supported by this platform — alongside a 4TB NVMe SSD. The machine weighs 3,640 g and occupies a footprint of 196 × 196 mm with a height of 94 mm.

On the graphics side, the integrated 80-core GPU supports up to eight simultaneous displays and delivers a **maximum memory bandwidth of 819 GB/s** over a PCIe 4 interface, with the GPU fabricated on a 3 nm process node. Connectivity includes two USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports, four USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C ports, one HDMI output, one RJ45 Ethernet port, a 3.5 mm audio jack, Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax), and Bluetooth 5.3. Benchmark results show a Geekbench 6 multi-core score of 27,749 and a single-core score of 3,221. The CPU carries an 80W TDP, uses a hybrid big.LITTLE core arrangement with HMP scheduling, and does not support simultaneous multithreading.

Pros

*   The 32-core CPU with 24 cores at 3.7 GHz and 8 at 3.4 GHz, combined with 512GB of DDR5 unified memory, provides substantial headroom for heavily threaded desktop workloads
*   Support for up to eight simultaneous displays makes this machine well-suited for multi-monitor desktop setups
*   A maximum memory bandwidth of 819 GB/s from the integrated 80-core GPU enables rapid data throughput for graphics-intensive tasks
*   The 4TB NVMe SSD delivers fast storage access in a form factor measuring just 196 x 196 x 94 mm
*   Wi-Fi 6E support alongside Bluetooth 5.3 covers both high-bandwidth wireless networking and modern peripheral connectivity
*   Hardware security features including TrustZone and NX bit support are built directly into the processor

Cons

*   No Thunderbolt 3 or Thunderbolt 4 ports are included, limiting compatibility with certain high-speed peripherals and docks that rely on those interfaces
*   There are no DisplayPort or USB 4 outputs, which restricts options for connecting some monitors and high-speed external devices
*   ECC memory is not supported, which may be a consideration for workloads where memory error correction is a requirement
*   The absence of S/PDIF output limits legacy professional audio routing options for users who depend on that interface
*   With no USB 2.0 or USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports available, older USB peripherals must rely on adapters to connect to the available Gen 2 ports

##### Who is this for?

This machine is well-matched to users who run **heavily threaded desktop workloads** that can take full advantage of a 32-core CPU and 512GB of DDR5 unified memory — such as large-scale data processing, complex computational tasks, or multi-stream media work. The integrated 80-core GPU with 819 GB/s memory bandwidth and support for **up to eight simultaneous displays** also makes it a strong fit for professionals managing extensive multi-monitor setups or driving high-resolution visual output across multiple screens. The compact 196 × 196 × 94 mm chassis paired with Wi-Fi 6E and a broad USB 3.2 Gen 2 port selection suits users who need a capable desktop workstation without sacrificing desk space.

##### Who is this NOT for?

Users who depend on **Thunderbolt 3 or Thunderbolt 4 connectivity** for high-speed external storage arrays, professional docks, or specialized peripherals will find the absence of those ports a meaningful limitation. Similarly, workflows that require **ECC memory** for error-corrected computation — common in certain scientific, financial, or mission-critical server-adjacent tasks — are not supported by this platform. Those who need DisplayPort outputs or USB 4 connections for specific display or device configurations will also encounter compatibility gaps without additional adapters.

The M3 Ultra's CPU is configured with **32 cores running across two clock speed tiers** — 24 cores at 3.7 GHz and 8 cores at 3.4 GHz — yielding 32 threads in total, though without simultaneous multithreading. It operates within an 80W TDP envelope, supports 64-bit computing, and includes integrated graphics. The processor also carries **32 MB of L2 cache**, and uses a heterogeneous core arrangement consistent with its big.LITTLE-style design.

This configuration of the Mac Studio 2025 includes **512GB of DDR5 unified memory**, representing the full capacity supported by this platform and providing substantial headroom for memory-intensive workloads.

The Mac Studio 2025 offers a well-rounded set of wired and wireless connectivity options. On the wireless side, it supports **Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax)** alongside Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 5, and Wi-Fi 4, and includes Bluetooth 5.3. Wired connections consist of two USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports and **four USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C ports**, along with one HDMI output, one RJ45 Ethernet port, and a 3.5 mm audio jack. There are no USB 2.0, USB 3.2 Gen 1, USB 4, Thunderbolt 3 or 4, DisplayPort, VGA, or S/PDIF ports included.

Classified as a desktop CPU, the M3 Ultra in the Mac Studio 2025 employs **big.LITTLE technology with Heterogeneous Multi-Processing (HMP)**, allowing the system to schedule tasks across its performance and efficiency cores simultaneously. The processor includes an NX bit and TrustZone support, contributing to its hardware-level security capabilities. Maximum supported memory tops out at 512GB, and while the platform does not support ECC memory, that ceiling aligns with the unified memory configuration available in this model.

##### Final Verdict

The Apple Mac Studio 2025 (M3 Ultra) is a compact desktop workstation built around an exceptionally high specification floor — 32 CPU cores, **512GB of DDR5 unified memory with 819 GB/s bandwidth**, a 4TB NVMe SSD, and support for up to eight simultaneous displays, all within a chassis barely larger than a hardback book. Its hardware security features, Wi-Fi 6E, and broad USB 3.2 Gen 2 port selection round out a well-considered feature set for stationary professional use. The absence of Thunderbolt and ECC memory support will matter to a specific subset of users, but for those whose workflows align with what this machine offers, it represents a highly capable and space-efficient desktop platform.

Apple no longer offers M3 Ultra Mac Studio with original highest RAM configuration
==================================================================================

 [![Avatar for Zac Hall](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/af01c840dac8281fd5f1986a8504e54222700437fa19c3083e578c1ddf6386a6?s=60&d=mm&r=r)](https://9to5mac.com/author/apollozac/)

 | Mar 5 2026 - 12:12 pm PT

[15 Comments](https://9to5mac.com/2026/03/05/apple-no-longer-offers-m3-ultra-mac-studio-with-original-highest-ram-configuration/#comments)

![Mac Studio m4 Max m3 ultra](https://i0.wp.com/9to5mac.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/6/2025/03/mac-studio-m4-max-m3-ultra.jpg?w=1500&quality=82&strip=all&ssl=1)

A year ago today, Apple unveiled the M4 Max and M3 Ultra Mac Studio desktop computer. In addition to Thunderbolt 5 and SSD storage configurable to 16TB, Apple advertised the Mac Studio as featuring up to 512GB of unified memory. As of this week, the highest RAM upgrade option is no longer available.

Apple [highlighted](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/03/apple-unveils-new-mac-studio-the-most-powerful-mac-ever/)
 the highest RAM configuration in the press release for the M3 Ultra Mac Studio:

> Mac Studio is a powerhouse for AI, capable of running large language models (LLMs) with over 600 billion parameters entirely in memory, thanks to its advanced GPU and up to 512GB of unified memory with M3 Ultra — the most ever in a personal computer.

As [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/03/05/mac-studio-no-512gb-ram-upgrade/)
 notes, customers ordering a new M3 Ultra Mac Studio today no longer have the option to configure the desktop Mac with 512GB RAM. The issue is likely due to global supply constraints thanks in large part to high memory needs for servers powering AI.

The M3 Ultra Mac Studio still offers the most configurable RAM in a Mac with its 256GB memory option. That’s compared to the M2 Ultra Mac Pro which offers up to 192GB RAM, and M4 Max/M5 Max machines that support up to 128GB RAM.

### The Bottom Line

The M3 Ultra-equipped Apple Mac Studio delivers the massive multi-core performance and workstation grunt that pros with demanding workflows need. However, its high price and older core architecture mean the M4 Max model is more versatile—and accessible.

Pros & Cons
-----------

*   M3 Ultra delivers unparalleled performance for specific workflows
*   Massive memory and storage capacity
*   Enhanced connectivity, with six Thunderbolt 5 ports

*   Prohibitively expensive for casual use, especially in top configurations
*   Newer, cheaper M4 Max is better than M3 Ultra in some cases
*   No Wi-Fi 7

Apple Mac Studio (2025, M3 Ultra) Specs
---------------------------------------

| Name | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Desktop Class | Workstation |
| Processor | Apple M3 Ultra |
| RAM (as Tested) | 256 GB |
| Boot Drive Type | SSD |
| Boot Drive Capacity (as Tested) | 4 TB |
| Graphics Card | Apple M3 Ultra (80-core) |
| Operating System | Apple macOS Sequoia |

More Specs

The M3 Ultra version of the Mac Studio (starts at $3,999; $8,099 as tested) is the apex of Apple computers, capable of everything from editing 8K video and rendering complex CGI to running massive AI models on your own machine. From media editing to engineering, the Mac Studio is Apple's contender for the most powerful [workstation desktop](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-desktop-workstations)
 you can buy. (Even the tower-style Mac Pro is little more than a Mac Studio in a larger box.)

The 2025 Mac Studio has two essential versions, delineated by their CPU: the M4 Max and the M3 Ultra. Both are seriously powerful, and a meaningful upgrade over the previous models from 2023. However, the two processor offerings and slightly different feature sets may cause some confusion about which system is best for you and your work, not to mention your budget. That's why we've performed extensive testing on the Mac Studio with M3 Ultra, to let you know when it's worth shelling out more for this more expensive and more powerful model. (Spoiler: The M3 Ultra model does offer top power for the most demanding tasks, but the [Mac Studio with M4 Max](https://www.pcmag.com/reviews/apple-mac-studio-2025-m4-max)
 gets our Editors’ Choice award over this one. Read on to learn why.)

**_Editor's Note (March 12, 2025):_** _This review was updated to include 3DMark graphics test results which were not available at the time of publishing. The overall rating has not changed._

Design: The M3 Ultra's Beastly Architecture
-------------------------------------------

The Mac Studio comes with your choice of two different processors: the single-chip M4 Max, which is the default for the base model, or the M3 Ultra, which costs an additional $2,000. The M3 Ultra, as the name suggests, is based upon the M3 Max, Apple's top-of-the-line single-chip [processor from 2023](https://www.pcmag.com/articles/apple-silicon-m3-cpus-tested-the-macs-most-advanced-chips-yet-compared)
.

![Apple Mac Studio (2025, M3 Ultra)](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20768%20432'%3E%3Crect%20fill='%23f7f7f7'%20/%3E%3C/svg%3E)

(Credit: Brian Westover)

The M3 Ultra combines two M3 Max chips with Apple's proprietary UltraFusion silicon interposer, which bridges the two with an ultra-low latency connection, allowing the two chips to function and show up in software as one. The result is twice the compute cores, twice the bandwidth, a dramatic increase in the number of graphics cores, and support for more than half a terabyte of RAM.

This chip is engineered for professionals who require the highest level of performance in areas like 8K [video editing](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-video-editing-software)
, 3D rendering, and complex simulations. But it's crucial to understand that while it is the current top-tier chip, it is based on previous-gen hardware. This means that compared with the M4 Max, it's running an older core architecture without the refinements and optimizations made for the M4 series. 

The result is an undeniably powerful chip, and it is rightly called the most powerful chip that Apple currently offers. But that doesn't mean it's the best chip for every use case and every user.

First, a bit about the box it's in. On the outside, the Mac Studio looks quite familiar, since the external design is unchanged from the previous two iterations. One look at the pictures included in this review will tell you everything you need to know. The Mac Studio uses an all-aluminum construction for the cube-like chassis. This aluminum housing sits 3.7 inches tall and has a 7.7-inch square footprint, making it extremely compact and able to fit on any desk. The aluminum construction is more than just an aesthetic choice, though—it also functions as a heatsink for the hardware inside.

The Mac Studio is built for airflow, with a ring-shaped air intake on the bottom, circling the round foot that serves as the base of the Mac Studio. On the back side of the Studio, just above the rear ports, hundreds of little holes make up the exhaust ventilation. Inside the compact chassis is an extremely quiet fan that pulls cool air in and pushes hot air out, with a custom-designed heatsink dissipating heat from the processor. 

For this step-up model of the Mac Studio, a copper heatsink cools the processors, offering more effective cooling than the aluminum cooling block used in the base model. The change in material accounts for the near-2-pound difference between the M4 Max (6.1 pounds) and M3 Ultra models (8.0 pounds). Inside that heatsink is a vapor chamber for additional cooling efficiency.

Configuration: How Much Memory and Storage Can You Afford?
----------------------------------------------------------

The Mac Studio comes in several configurations, starting with a base model that uses the M4 Max 14-core processor with a 32-core GPU and 16-core neural engine. With a default allotment of 36GB of unified memory and 512GB of SSD storage, this version of the Mac Studio starts at $1,999. You can scale up the memory and storage as high as 128GB and 8TB, respectively, taking the price as high as $5,899.

![Apple Mac Studio (2025, M3 Ultra) base](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20768%20432'%3E%3Crect%20fill='%23f7f7f7'%20/%3E%3C/svg%3E)

(Credit: Brian Westover)

But you can also get the Mac Studio with the M3 Ultra chip we have here, and that's a different beast. The $3,999 "basic" M3 Ultra model features a 28-core CPU, a 60-core GPU, and a 32-core neural engine, along with 96GB memory and 1TB of SSD storage—hardly basic, but the entry point if you want the dual CPU.

The M3 Ultra Mac Studio we tested steps that up further with the 32-core version of the M3 Ultra. That version of the chip also bumps up the GPU (to 80 cores) and pairs that with 256GB of memory and 4TB of SSD storage. These upgrades push the price up to $8,099. 

_Really_ want to push this as far as it can go? The memory can scale as high as 512GB and the SSD to 16TB, ringing up at a cool $14,099. That is, obviously, not a system meant for the average consumer but for professional creators who require extreme levels of performance and storage—and who have the budget to spend accordingly.

You may also want to budget for peripherals (which are all sold separately) and for extended AppleCare+ coverage, since the Mac Studio comes with a one-year warranty and only 90 days of free tech support.

Features and Connectivity: Thunderbolt 5 and Beyond
---------------------------------------------------

The M3 Ultra model features enhanced connectivity, including [Thunderbolt 5](https://www.pcmag.com/explainers/what-is-thunderbolt-5)
 ports on both the front and rear, providing blazing-fast data transfer speeds of up to 120Gbps and support for native DisplayPort 2.1 output.

![Apple Mac Studio (2025, M3 Ultra) rear ports](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20768%20432'%3E%3Crect%20fill='%23f7f7f7'%20/%3E%3C/svg%3E)

(Credit: Brian Westover)

Four of the Thunderbolt ports are on the back of the machine, where you'll also find two USB Type-A ports, an HDMI 2.1 output, a 10Gbps Ethernet jack, and a headphone jack. On the front, you'll get two more Thunderbolt 5 ports (for a total of six) and an SDXC card slot that makes it easy to grab photos and video right from camera storage without an adapter.

![Apple Mac Studio (2025, M3 Ultra) front ports](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20768%20432'%3E%3Crect%20fill='%23f7f7f7'%20/%3E%3C/svg%3E)

(Credit: Brian Westover)

Between the Thunderbolt ports and the HDMI output, you can have eight displays running at 6K resolution at 60Hz or 4K resolution at up to 144Hz. Alternatively, you can set up four displays at 8K resolution at 60Hz or 4K resolution at up to 240Hz.

Wireless connectivity includes [Wi-Fi 6E](https://www.pcmag.com/news/what-is-wi-fi-6e)
 and Bluetooth 5.3. Interestingly enough, [Wi-Fi 7](https://www.pcmag.com/explainers/from-80211b-to-wi-fi-7-what-do-wi-fi-numbers-mean)
 is not available for this machine, despite being the latest standard, but I suspect most users operating in these rarified spheres will be relying on the Studio's 10Gbps Ethernet connection for networking needs.

Using the Mac Studio: AI, macOS Sequoia Come Standard
-----------------------------------------------------

The M3 Ultra-based Mac Studio leverages [macOS Sequoia](https://www.pcmag.com/reviews/apple-macos-sequoia)
 and [Apple Intelligence](https://www.pcmag.com/news/apple-intelligence-launches-with-ios-181-heres-what-you-get)
 to deliver a seamless and powerful user experience. The enhanced Neural Engine and increased memory bandwidth ensure optimal performance for AI-driven tasks.

Part of this is Apple Intelligence, which gives users a combination of on-device and on-cloud AI integrated into everything from [writing and summarization](https://www.pcmag.com/how-to/how-to-use-apple-intelligence-ai-writing-tools-rewrite-proofread-summarize)
 tools to photo enhancements and [image generation](https://www.pcmag.com/how-to/how-to-generate-ai-images-with-apple-intelligences-image-playground)
. Most or all of these features are available to anyone with an Apple system based on an M-series processor, but the new M3 Ultra should offer the best performance possible for these new tools, thanks to the enhanced Neural Engine, upgraded GPU, and expanded memory bandwidth.

The 2025 Mac Studio also comes with the latest macOS version, Sequoia, which introduces several major enhancements that earlier Mac Studio models lacked at their respective launches. These include features like on-screen iPhone mirroring, improved window management, and enhanced performance due to Apple's seamless hardware and software integration.

![iPhone screen mirroring](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20768%20432'%3E%3Crect%20fill='%23f7f7f7'%20/%3E%3C/svg%3E)

(Credit: Apple/PCMag)

However, it's important to mention that not all of these upgrades are exclusive to this Mac Studio model. Sequoia is available for free to all M-series Mac users, along with many of its features.

A final note before we get into the benchmarks: Although the Mac Studio is not ISV-certified the way non-Mac workstation systems are, Apple partners with software developers to make third-party apps and tools for Mac seamlessly integrate into the Apple ecosystem, such as Adobe's Creative Suite. It also designs apps in-house, such as Logic Pro for audio editing, making the Mac Studio a capable and reliable workstation-level desktop.

Testing the 2025 Mac Studio: Evaluating the Monster M3 Ultra
------------------------------------------------------------

The Mac Studio is more than just a compact desktop; it's also a very powerful workstation machine, meaning that most desktops can't hold a candle to it. For this reason, we focused most of our comparisons on the most recent Mac Studio models, including the new [M4 Max model](https://www.pcmag.com/reviews/apple-mac-studio-2025-m4-max)
 and the [2023 Mac Studio with M2 Ultra](https://www.pcmag.com/reviews/apple-mac-studio-m2-ultra-2023)
. 

For some broader context, we've also compared it with the [Apple iMac with M4](https://www.pcmag.com/reviews/apple-imac-2024-m4)
. With no Pro, Max, or Ultra attached, that comparison illustrates just how far from mainstream the Mac Studio is in terms of performance and capability.

### Productivity and Content Creation Tests 

We run the same general productivity benchmarks across both mobile and desktop systems. For Macs, that means three benchmarks focus on the CPU, using all available cores and threads, to rate a PC's suitability for processor-intensive workloads. Maxon's Cinebench 2024 uses the Cinema 4D engine to render a complex scene, while Geekbench 6.3 Pro from Primate Labs simulates popular apps ranging from PDF rendering and speech recognition to machine learning. Finally, we use the open-source video transcoder HandBrake 1.8 to convert a 12-minute video clip from 4K to 1080p resolution (lower times are better).

We also run PugetBench for Photoshop by workstation maker Puget Systems. It works with the 2024 version of Adobe's famous image editor to rate a PC's performance for content creation and multimedia applications. It's an automated extension that executes a variety of general and GPU-accelerated Photoshop tasks ranging from opening, rotating, resizing, and saving an image to applying masks, gradient fills, and filters.

In Cinebench 2024, the Mac Studio with M3 Ultra led the pack by a giant margin, scoring more than 3,000 points—nearly 1,000 points more than the Mac Studio with M4 Max. And compared with something more pedestrian, like the Apple iMac, which uses a standard M4 processor, the difference in multicore processing performance is vast. However, if you look at single-core rendering performance, the M3 Ultra stops being so dominant. Because it uses M3 core technology, even the Apple iMac outpaced it in single-core performance.

We saw a similar split between multi-core and single-core performance in Geekbench Pro 6.3, where the M3 Ultra delivered category-leading scores in multi-core productivity testing but landed squarely in the middle of the pack for single-core performance due to the use of last-gen core technology.

Our Handbrake video transcoding test really drives home what that multi-core performance can do by showing how quickly the M3 Ultra's 32 processing cores can rip through a task. In this case, it converted our 12-minute 4K video file in 1 minute and 24 seconds. The M4 Max model took more than 2 minutes, while the M4 iMac took nearly 5. Even among high-performance systems, sub-2-minute times are rare, illustrating how quickly the raw power of the M3 Ultra can get through demanding tasks that are written to leverage all of its cores. 

Finally, you can see the difference between the M3 Ultra and the M4 Max in Adobe Photoshop, where the cheaper 16-core model delivered higher overall performance scores in photo editing and manipulation than the 32 cores of the M3 Ultra. It all highlights the fact that you need to choose the right processor for your use cases, with the cheaper M4 Max Mac Studio serving tasks like photo editing better.

### Graphics and Gaming Tests

Our Mac graphics and game testing starts with UL's 3DMark test suite, which uses the same animations and gaming simulations we use to test Windows machines.

Wild Life Extreme (4K) and Steel Nomad Light measure GPU speeds and gaming performance on Mac using Metal, Apple's proprietary graphics API, which is optimized for macOS and iOS devices. Steel Nomad Light's subtests also focus on gaming geometry and particle effects. 

We also use 3DMark's Solar Bay benchmark, which measures ray tracing performance in a synthetic environment. This benchmark works with Apple's Metal API and subjects 3D scenes to increasingly intense ray-traced workloads.

Finally, we use the built-in benchmark in Total War: Warhammer III for real-world gaming performance.

Despite the M3 Ultra's giant 80-core GPU, it wasn't the leader in our graphics tests. It usually took second place to the less expensive M4 Max and even fell short of other M4 chips—a testament to the GPU core enhancements introduced in the M4 series. As a result, the M3 Ultra fell behind in Wild Life Extreme and Solar Bay tests, though it produced the top score in Steel Nomad Light, leveraging those many GPU cores for exceptional performance with particle effects.

In our Warhammer III gaming tests, the M3 Ultra provided outstanding performance and better-than-playable frame rates at both Ultra and Low detail settings, indicating capable gaming performance. If you are in the unique class of gamers who are also Mac diehards and pro content creators, the M3 Ultra will definitely let you scratch that itch with support for the most demanding games you can get for Mac. 

But if you want the best gaming experience, the less-expensive M4 Max version of the Mac Studio is the better choice. In this same test, under the same settings, the M4 Max delivered higher frame rates and noticeably smoother gameplay at all detail settings. (Of course, gaming is a secondary concern on these machines; for the price of our tested M3 Ultra-based Mac Studio, you could buy a pile of gaming consoles and games likely taller than you are, plus a superb TV to play them on.)

### Workstation-Specific Tests 

The Mac Studio isn't just another desktop but a full-fledged workstation with the processing and graphics muscle to take on work in fields like engineering, medical imaging, and rendering CGI video. This level of performance demands some more thorough testing. To do that, we have a handful of workstation-tier tests, which include video editing in Adobe Premiere Pro 24, further editing in Blackmagic's DaVinci Resolve Studio, and rendering tests in Blender, targeting both CPU and GPU performance.

Each of these tests produces a numeric score. The fine distinctions between them aren't really important here, only the fact that a higher score means faster and more powerful performance.

In Adobe Premiere Pro, a professional-grade video editing program, the M3 Ultra really delivered on its promise of superior power, outperforming the M4 Max and showcasing its better suitability for professional-grade video editing workflows.

The M3 Ultra Mac Studio did the same in DaVinci Resolve, blazing past the M4 Max in video editing and color-correction tasks, proving that it's the processor of choice for professional editors.

Finally, in both CPU and GPU rendering tests in Blender, the M3 Ultra offered best-in-class performance, sticking the landing as the better choice for video work.

Final Thoughts
--------------

![https://i.pcmag.com/imagery/reviews/06pawXEsEXLZ99jZAJfZoXA-3..v1741636135.jpg](https://i.pcmag.com/imagery/reviews/06pawXEsEXLZ99jZAJfZoXA-3..v1741636135.jpg) (Credit: Brian Westover)

### Apple Mac Studio (2025, M3 Ultra)

4.0

Excellent

If our tests showed anything, it's that the 2025 Apple Mac Studio with M3 Ultra has fantastically powerful processors that are perfect for the most demanding video and rendering tasks that an engineer or 3D animator can throw at it. But that doesn't make it the best choice for every user.

For tasks like photo editing and gaming, the updated core architecture of the M4 Max offers better and faster performance. But when raw power is needed in an application that can leverage all the cores it can get, the doubled-up M3 Ultra proves its worth. The individual cores may not be as powerful as those on the Mac Studio with M4 Max, but the sheer number of CPU and GPU cores will deliver top performance in the most demanding applications. 

If that's the sort of processing muscle you need for professional media work or mission-critical engineering and design, then the M3 Ultra is absolutely worth the extra expense. It's an investment that will pay off with faster project completion and smoother day-to-day work. But this does make the M3 Ultra Mac Studio more of a niche product than the M4 Max base configuration.

The end result? The 2025 Apple Mac Studio with M3 Ultra is a monster of a workstation that gets our recommendation for offices and studios that need unbridled power and are able to budget for it. (If you need this kind of multicore processing power, it's very likely that you know it.) For everyone else, the M4 Max configuration is the better Mac Studio and our top recommendation overall.
